title: 连续尺寸矩形装入相似矩形

knownBest.source: Area comparison gives rs²≥r, hence s≥1. With r=1, one unit square fills the unit square container and attains s=1.
Maurizio Morandi (June 2015), compiled by Erich Friedman. The exact short-side formula is quoted from the table, without a global optimality claim. The site uses an ordinary shelf starter.
